title: calymenia nyctaginea
intro: Calymenia nyctaginea, commonly known as Night-blooming Jasmine, is a flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is a climbing plant that produces fragrant, star-shaped flowers that bloom at night and wilt by the next day, releasing their fragrance to attract pollinators. The health benefits of Calymenia nyctaginea include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and anti-anxiety effects.
